dct_description_sm: This record covers single maps of Providence, which are not represented in the LC database by separate catalog records.This collection includes single printed maps and may also include some multi-sheet single maps, plates from atlases, books or periodicals, and printed facsimiles. These maps may show various subjects, including landowners and recreation and tourism. To request a specific map or for more information, contact a reference librarian in the Geography & Map Division (202) 707-6277 or through the "Ask a librarian" link through the Geography & Map Division website https://ask.loc.gov/map-geography/.
